decision: PanelSettings is the user-visible preference definition; PanelSettings.test explicitly identifies 400/800 as original defaults and expects two columns. Rust normalizes these defaults; this is not exact legacy consumer fallback parity.

observed_fixture_check.result: Storage keys/values are redacted fixture placeholders; no recoverable runtime values for thresholds or columns. Visual-data fixture is synthetic and cannot adjudicate these defaults.

new_consumer_defaults: Only DesktopBehaviorPreferences::default; consumers receive typed saved values, no page fallback numbers.
